title: October 2026 — Kurzy trade/specialist screening
scope: User supplied 24 construction and specialist-service candidates; not all were independently verified; expanded: shareholder, controlling-group and direct external-customer screening

rules.strict_logic: A lead can have a weighted score/package only after a repeatable exact-IČO no-owned-website check. Unknown or partially searched = HOLD. Related-name sites require legal matching.
rules.eligibility_definition: ALL mandatory: exact legal entity match (IČO); company is not majority-owned/controlled by another business/parent; company has independently verified public/direct external-customer offering and contact/sales channel (B2B allowed); real operating business; and existing strict first-party no-website gate. A group-related brand, SPV, internal-service entity or entity relying solely on mother-company sales is excluded or held.
rules.conservative_group_qa: Definitive corporate-owned firms are excluded. Shared directors, family names, shared addresses or similar branding only trigger research hold; do not assert a legal parent unless commercial-register shareholder control is confirmed.
